headline: Trilegal, CMS INDUSLAW, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader act on TD Power Systems ₹600 crore QIP
sum: TD Power Systems Limited has raised ₹600 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement of 77,41,935 equity shares. Trilegal advised TD Power Systems on this QIP, according to the placement document.
detail: TD Power Systems Limited has raised ₹600 crore from a Qualified Institutions Placement of 77,41,935 equity shares. Trilegal advised TD Power Systems on this QIP, according to the placement document. CMS INDUSLAW advised Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Limited, the placement agent, on this QIP. The transaction team consisted of Mathew Thomas (Partner), Aman Bahl (Senior Associate), Ridhi Jain (Senior Associate), Kirti Gohil (Senior Associate), Associates Preeti Gokhale, Nikita S., Sahil Mehta, Anupriya Dasila and Anushka Pawar.
